verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing claims you can 'understand production systems faster using natural language' and lists an AI-powered Grafana Assistant and Investigations. An official MCP server (hosted and open source) lets external AI agents drive Grafana conversationally. The evidence is only thin marketing lines, though, and only covers understanding or investigating, not operating the product. Missing for 10: documented detail on what the Assistant can do via natural language (e.g. building dashboards, creating alerts, writing queries), evidence that natural-language operation is available in OSS/self-managed Grafana and not only Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
